en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a rural town nestled among rolling hills and forests. Farm fields and trees fill the foreground, while in the distance there is a clustered village with traditional gabled houses and a prominent church with a tall spire. The landscape extends to low hills on the horizon. Printed text at the upper left reads "Altenberg i. Erzgeb." indicating the place depicted.
